title: ICPC Uncovers Extra Particulars Towards Pretend Agency DG
text:
The Impartial Corrupt Practices and Different Associated Offences Commission (ICPC) has uncovered additional particulars of the alleged N30.8 billion fraud involving Adeniyi Adeyemi, who reportedly introduced himself because the Director-General of the non-existent Presidential International Intervention Promotion Council (PFIPC).
Adeyemi appeared earlier than the Excessive Court of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday, October 29, the place he was re-arraigned on a 22-count cost bordering on forgery, impersonation, acquiring cash underneath false pretences and different alleged {financial} crimes.
The contemporary expenses include allegations that Adeyemi tried to safe greater than N27 billion from the Federal Government as a take-off grant for the purported company.
He was additionally accused of searching for one other N3.8 billion to cowl personnel bills for the organisation, which the prosecution maintains was by no means legally established.
The case is being prosecuted by the ICPC following the withdrawal of an earlier cost filed towards him by the Federal Government on the Federal Excessive Court in Abuja.
Based on the prosecution, Adeyemi allegedly relied on solid authorities paperwork to present the impression that the PFIPC was an formally recognised establishment working underneath the Presidency.
The paperwork have been reportedly used to hunt authorities funding, receive official amenities and set up administrative buildings for the organisation.
The fee additional alleged that a few of the paperwork carried the purported signatures and authority of senior authorities officers, together with the Chief of Staff to the President, Femi Gbajabiamila.
One of many main allegations considerations an appointment letter dated March 8, 2024, which allegedly introduced Adeyemi because the Director-General of the PFIPC.
The prosecution claimed that the letter was solid and used to safe recognition from authorities establishments.
It additionally accused him of occupying workplace amenities on the Federal Secretariat Advanced, Section III, Abuja, the place he allegedly carried out actions related to a authorities company regardless of the absence of authorized authorisation.
The ICPC additional alleged that Adeyemi produced a doc introduced as an official authorities laws establishing the Presidential {Economic} Advisory Council and the Presidential International Intervention Promotion Council.
The doc was reportedly meant to make the organisation seem to have been created via a longtime authorized course of.
One other allegation considerations a purported Govt Order No. 5, dated February 24, 2023, which allegedly claimed to ascertain the PFIPC.
The fee maintained that the doc was fabricated and subsequently used to present legitimacy to the organisation and its actions.
The prosecution additionally listed a doc allegedly addressed to the Accountant-General of the Federation, with the heading “Re: Request for approval of self-accounting standing”.
Based on the fee, the doc was allegedly ready to allow the purported company to function inside the Federal Government’s {financial} reporting construction. This may have allowed the organisation to perform as if it had the required authorities approval and {financial} recognition.
The ICPC additional accused Adeyemi of forging correspondence addressed to the Director-General of the Nationwide Info Know-how Growth Agency (NITDA). The paperwork allegedly sought approval for the registration of an official area title for the PFIPC.
The alleged try to safe authorities funding additionally featured prominently within the 22-count cost.
One of many paperwork reportedly introduced to the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economic system contained a request for the discharge of N27,395,510,136 as a take-off grant for the purported Presidential {Economic} Advisory Council and PFIPC.
The fee additionally accused Adeyemi of making an attempt to safe N3,850,935,000 because the proposed 2026 personnel funds for the organisations.
It alleged that he ready and used paperwork on purported State House letterheads to help the requests.
The paperwork have been allegedly designed to persuade related authorities workplaces that the organisations had been correctly established and have been entitled to public funding.
Past the alleged makes an attempt to acquire authorities funds, the ICPC accused Adeyemi of utilizing {financial} inducements to safe help from public officers.
One of many allegations considerations N210,000 allegedly given to Aminu Abdullahi, an Assistant Chief Technical Officer within the Workplace of the Secretary to the Authorities of the Federation (OSGF).
The fee claimed that the cash was offered “to facilitate the allocation of workplace house” on the Federal Secretariat with out the required official authorisation.
Adeyemi was additionally accused of giving N300,000 to Ogaba Harry, an officer within the Workplace of the Chief {Economic} Adviser to the President.
The prosecution alleged that the cost was meant to facilitate the discharge and handover of two authorities autos, recognized as a Toyota Prado SUV and a Toyota Land Cruiser SUV.
The fee additional raised allegations involving a non-public firm, Divine Dopacy Nigeria Restricted, and its Managing Director, Oyekunle Gbenga.
Based on the cost, Adeyemi allegedly collected N20 million from Gbenga on July 29, 2025, underneath the outline of a “venture facilitation mortgage”.
The cash was reportedly related to a purported N2.8 billion contract allegedly awarded by the fictional company for the procurement of furnishings and renovation of the official residence of its supposed Director-General.
In a separate allegation contained within the contemporary cost, the prosecution additionally accused Adeyemi of acquiring N380 million from Gbenga between Might and June 2025.
The cash was allegedly paid into an account belonging to World Entrepreneurship College Restricted underneath the pretence of facilitating the identical purported venture.
The ICPC stated the alleged offences have been dedicated between 2024 and 2026. It listed provisions of the Penal Code, the Advance Fee Fraud and Different Fraud-Associated Offences Act, 2006, and the Corrupt Practices and Different Associated Offences Act, 2000, because the authorized foundation for the prosecution.
Throughout Thursday’s proceedings, Adeyemi pleaded not responsible to all 22 counts after the fees have been learn to him.
The ICPC’s prosecuting counsel, Fatima Bardi, subsequently requested the court docket to repair a date for the graduation of trial. She additionally requested that the defendant be remanded in custody pending additional proceedings.
Nonetheless, his defence counsel, Ibrahim Angulu (SAN), made an oral utility for bail.
Justice Halilu Yusuf declined to entertain the oral utility and directed the defence to submit a proper written utility earlier than the court docket may take into account the request.
Angulu accepted the directive however appealed for an early listening to of the matter. He informed the court docket that his shopper had remained in detention for 155 days and was experiencing well being challenges.
The defence lawyer additionally knowledgeable the court docket that he had obtained a medical report from the police clinic the place Adeyemi had reportedly acquired remedy.
He urged the court docket to take his shopper’s extended detention and well being situation into consideration when fixing the following listening to date.
Justice Yusuf subsequently adjourned the matter till November 9, 2026, for the graduation of trial and additional proceedings.
Adeyemi was arrested in Osun State on July 14, 2026, following an order for his arrest after he reportedly did not honour court docket summons.
He has remained in custody since then.
Adeyemi had additionally made allegations towards Gbajabiamila, claiming that the Chief of Staff to President Bola Tinubu acquired N400 million via a proxy to facilitate his appointment as Director-General of the purported company.
Gbajabiamila has denied the allegation.
President Tinubu subsequently directed the ICPC to analyze the controversy.
The fee’s chairman, Musa Aliyu, had earlier disclosed that preliminary findings confirmed that Adeyemi was not appointed by the Federal Government.
The fee additionally stated the purported appointment letter, gazette and different paperwork used to ascertain the organisation have been solid.
Recall that on September 30, 2026, Adeyemi was initially arraigned earlier than the Federal Excessive Court in Abuja on an eight-count cost following investigations into the alleged actions of the PFIPC.
Nonetheless, on October 12, the Director of Public Prosecutions of the Federation, Rotimi Oyedepo (SAN), withdrew the sooner cost after informing the court docket that the Federal Government meant to pursue the case earlier than the FCT Excessive Court.
The choice adopted a overview of the case by the Legal professional-General of the Federation and Minister of Justice, with the prosecution sustaining that the FCT Excessive Court was the suitable court docket to deal with the alleged offences.
The sooner proceedings have been subsequently struck out, paving the way in which for the contemporary arraignment.
